identity.name: Cloud Posture Drift Correlated to Runtime Cause — Cortex Cloud CSPM (T1562 / T1578 / T1530)
identity.summary: A compliant resource drifts out of baseline: an S3 bucket's Block Public Access is removed and a CloudTrail trail's logging is stopped. Cortex Cloud CSPM flags the drift and correlates each finding with the control-plane action that caused it and the external access that followed — posture-to-runtime stitching, not a static snapshot.
identity.description: A single point-in-time posture snapshot tells you a resource is misconfigured; it does not tell you a resource that was compliant yesterday is exposed today, who changed it, or whether the exposure was reached. Configuration drift — the silent regression of a resource away from an approved compliant baseline — is the failure mode behind a large share of real cloud breaches, and Unit 42's Cloud Threat Report repeatedly names misconfiguration and drift as the top cloud risk. This scenario exercises Cortex Cloud CSPM's drift-and-correlation capability rather than its flat-scan capability. A drift-target S3 bucket (tagged CortexSimDriftTarget) starts in a known-compliant state: account-level Block Public Access enabled, versioning on, SSE-KMS, and a dedicated CloudTrail trail actively logging. The scenario then injects two authorized, reversible drifts against a disposable lab resource: (a) DeletePublicAccessBlock plus a public bucket policy, flipping the bucket from private to world-readable (the precondition for T1530 Data from Cloud Storage), and (b) StopLogging on the trail, blinding audit capture (T1562.008 Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs). Both are captured in cloud_audit_logs before the trail goes dark, and both regress the resource's compliance_state from compliant to drifted in cortex_cloud_posture. Detection is deliberately Analytics/XQL/Correlation, not behavioral-ML: posture is configuration state, so the validation queries assert the baseline was compliant, that each resource drifted, that the drift-causing control-plane API call is attributable to a principal, and that external data access reached the now-public bucket. A correlation rule fuses the two drift findings with their runtime cause and the post-drift access into one posture-drift incident, so a DC can show Cortex catching not just an exposed bucket but the moment it became exposed, the identity responsible, and the exploitation that followed — the whole drift chain in a single stitched event. This closes the CSPM plane-floor gap (the plane previously shipped only one flat-scan scenario) with the correlation-forward posture story that differentiates Cortex Cloud from a checkbox compliance scanner.

actors.name: Cloud insiders and credential-abusing intruders who weaken guardrails before acting (misconfiguration/drift exploitation)

campaigns: Guardrail-weakening and configuration drift preceding cloud data theft

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-CSPM-002 — Inject reversible posture drift + reconcile drift findings against their CloudTrail cause

prerequisites.description: Cortex Cloud CSPM enabled and connected (read-only) to the target AWS account with drift tracking on.

A disposable drift-target S3 bucket and a dedicated CloudTrail trail exist in a known-compliant baseline (Block Public Access on, versioning on, SSE-KMS, trail logging enabled), tagged CortexSimDriftTarget.

payload.code:
# Posture drift injection (authorized, reversible) — flip a compliant resource
# out of baseline and let Cortex Cloud CSPM correlate the drift to its cause.
set -euo pipefail
aws s3api delete-public-access-block --bucket "${DRIFT_BUCKET:-cortexsim-drift-target}" --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-cortexsim-lab}" || true
aws cloudtrail stop-logging --name "${DRIFT_TRAIL:-cortexsim-trail}" --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-cortexsim-lab}" || true
curl -fsS --max-time 8 "https://${DRIFT_BUCKET:-cortexsim-drift-target}.s3.amazonaws.com/" | head -c 400 || true

input_variables.name: DRIFT_BUCKET
input_variables.description: Disposable lab S3 bucket that drifts from compliant to public.

input_variables.name: DRIFT_TRAIL
input_variables.description: Dedicated CloudTrail trail whose logging is stopped to model T1562.008.

input_variables.name: AWS_PROFILE
input_variables.description: Named AWS CLI profile scoped to the disposable drift-target resources.

expected_artifacts.description: Control-plane action that causes the drift — public-access-block removal or CloudTrail StopLogging attributed to a principal.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: event_name in (DeletePublicAccessBlock, PutBucketPolicy, StopLogging) and user_identity_arn contains "cortexsim-lab"

expected_artifacts.description: The drift-target resource regresses from compliant to drifted in the posture inventory.

cleanup.code: aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket "${DRIFT_BUCKET:-cortexsim-drift-target}" --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-cortexsim-lab}" || true; aws cloudtrail start-logging --name "${DRIFT_TRAIL:-cortexsim-trail}" --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-cortexsim-lab}" || true; echo '[CortexSim] SIM-CSPM-002 cleanup complete — compliant baseline restored (Block Public Access on, trail logging on).'

iocs.context: External (non-RFC1918, documentation-range stand-in) source that reads the drift-target bucket once its account-level Block Public Access is removed — the post-drift GetObject/ListBucket the 'Public Bucket Data Access Post Drift' query surfaces. Represents the constant background scanning that finds a newly-public bucket within minutes of the drift.

xql_queries.name: CSPM-002 Compliant Baseline Posture Snapshot
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and resource_type in ("aws_s3_bucket", "aws_cloudtrail")
| filter tags contains "CortexSimDriftTarget"
| filter compliance_state = "compliant"
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as compliant_baseline by resource_type
| fields resource_type, compliant_baseline

xql_queries.name: CSPM-002 S3 Public Access Block Removed Drift
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and resource_type = "aws_s3_bucket"
| filter tags contains "CortexSimDriftTarget"
| filter compliance_state = "drifted" and finding_class in ("public-access-block-removed", "bucket-policy-public")
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as drifted_buckets by finding_class
| filter drifted_buckets >= 1
| fields finding_class, drifted_buckets

xql_queries.name: CSPM-002 CloudTrail Logging Disabled Drift
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and resource_type = "aws_cloudtrail"
| filter tags contains "CortexSimDriftTarget"
| filter compliance_state = "drifted" and finding_class = "cloudtrail-logging-disabled"
| comp count_distinct(resource_id) as drifted_trails by finding_class
| filter drifted_trails >= 1
| fields finding_class, drifted_trails

xql_queries.name: CSPM-002 Runtime Control Plane Action Causing Drift
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and event_source in ("s3.amazonaws.com", "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com")
| filter event_name in ("DeletePublicAccessBlock", "PutBucketPolicy", "PutBucketAcl", "StopLogging", "UpdateTrail")
| comp count() as drift_actions by event_name, user_identity_arn
| filter drift_actions >= 1
| sort desc drift_actions
| fields event_name, user_identity_arn, drift_actions

xql_queries.name: CSPM-002 Public Bucket Data Access Post Drift
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cloud_audit_logs
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS" and event_source = "s3.amazonaws.com"
| filter event_name in ("GetObject", "ListObjects", "ListBucket")
| filter not incidr(src_ip, "10.0.0.0/8") and not incidr(src_ip, "172.16.0.0/12") and not incidr(src_ip, "192.168.0.0/16")
| comp count() as external_reads by bucket_name, src_ip
| filter external_reads >= 1
| fields bucket_name, src_ip, external_reads

xql_queries.name: CSPM-002 Posture Drift Coverage Reconciliation
xql_queries.query:
dataset = cortex_cloud_posture
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter cloud_provider = "AWS"
| filter tags contains "CortexSimDriftTarget"
| filter compliance_state = "drifted"
| filter finding_class in ("public-access-block-removed", "bucket-policy-public", "cloudtrail-logging-disabled")
| comp count_distinct(finding_class) as drift_classes
| filter drift_classes >= 2
| fields drift_classes

correlation_rules.name: Posture Drift Correlated to Runtime Cause and Exploitation
correlation_rules.logic: ( XQL(CSPM-002 S3 Public Access Block Removed Drift) OR XQL(CSPM-002 CloudTrail Logging Disabled Drift) ) AND XQL(CSPM-002 Runtime Control Plane Action Causing Drift) — fuses each posture-drift finding on a CortexSimDriftTarget resource with the CloudTrail control-plane action that caused it (and, when present, the post-drift external bucket access) into a single posture-drift incident that names the drifted resource, the responsible principal, and the exploitation window.

analytics_modules: Cortex Cloud CSPM — configuration drift detection against an approved compliant baseline
Cortex Cloud Posture — drift-to-runtime correlation (posture inventory joined to cloud_audit_logs)
Cortex XSIAM Analytics — attribution of the drift-causing control-plane action to a principal

products.evidence_query: dataset = cortex_cloud_posture | filter tags contains "CortexSimDriftTarget" and compliance_state = "drifted" | comp count_distinct(resource_id) by finding_class | fields finding_class, resource_id
Correlation CR-CSPM-0003 stitches each posture-drift finding to its CloudTrail control-plane cause and the post-drift external access into one posture-drift incident.
Prisma Cloud Compliance dashboard — drift events on CortexSim-tagged resources against the CIS AWS Foundations baseline.

use_cases.name: Cloud Posture Drift Detection & Runtime Correlation
use_cases.description: Cortex Cloud CSPM detects when a previously-compliant resource drifts out of baseline (public-access-block removed, CloudTrail logging disabled) and correlates each drift finding with the control-plane action that caused it and any post-drift exploitation, surfacing the whole drift chain as one incident.

test_cases.objective: An injected, reversible drift regresses a compliant resource to drifted and both drift classes surface within one scan cycle.
preconditions: Cortex Cloud CSPM connected (read-only) with drift tracking enabled.
Drift-target bucket + trail exist in a known-compliant baseline tagged CortexSimDriftTarget.
steps: Remove the bucket's Block Public Access and stop the trail's logging.
Observe both drift findings surface and the coverage reconciliation return drift_classes >= 2.
success_criteria: XQL `CSPM-002 S3 Public Access Block Removed Drift` returns >= 1.
XQL `CSPM-002 CloudTrail Logging Disabled Drift` returns >= 1.
XQL `CSPM-002 Posture Drift Coverage Reconciliation` returns drift_classes >= 2.

test_cases.objective: Each drift finding is correlated to the CloudTrail control-plane action that caused it (and post-drift access) into one incident.
preconditions: The drift-causing API calls (DeletePublicAccessBlock / StopLogging) are captured in cloud_audit_logs before the trail goes dark.
steps: Read the now-public bucket from an external source.
Observe CR-CSPM-0003 raise one posture-drift incident naming the resource, the principal, and the exploitation window.
success_criteria: XQL `CSPM-002 Runtime Control Plane Action Causing Drift` returns >= 1 attributed to a principal.
Correlation CR-CSPM-0003 raises a posture-drift incident stitching the drift finding to its runtime cause.

preventive_controls: Enforce account-level S3 Block Public Access and prohibit its removal via SCP so a bucket cannot drift to public.
Protect CloudTrail with an SCP denying StopLogging/DeleteTrail/UpdateTrail except to a break-glass role, and enable log-file validation.
Require change tickets and drift-guardrail policy (Prisma Cloud / AWS Config rules) that auto-revert unauthorized configuration changes on the compliant baseline.
detection_engineering: Track compliance_state transitions (compliant -> drifted) per resource rather than only point-in-time misconfiguration snapshots.
Join the posture inventory to cloud_audit_logs so every drift finding names the control-plane action and principal that caused it.
Escalate a drift finding to an incident when the drifted exposure is reached at runtime (external GetObject on the newly-public bucket).

changelog.change: Initial CSPM posture-drift-and-correlation card for SIM-CSPM-002 (CSPM plane-floor rescue). Real cloud-posture XQL against cortex_cloud_posture / cloud_audit_logs validating a compliant->drifted transition (S3 Block-Public-Access removed + CloudTrail StopLogging), attribution of the drift-causing control-plane action to a principal, post-drift external bucket access, and correlation CR-CSPM-0003 stitching drift findings to their runtime cause. Analytics/XQL/Correlation only (posture, not behavioral-ML): no ABIOCs. Promoted to active.
